_comment: Baselines for the AIR erasure gate. total_unproven_retain = bucket-C ceiling (C must never grow). provable_fixtures_must_be_clean = programs that must carry zero axis calls and nothing beyond the substrate floor. substrate_floor = the named Sync/Abort symbols EVERY emitted program carries regardless of axis use; the gate pins the control fixture (00_pure_value) to exactly this set, so floor growth is RED until a human commits a new baseline with attribution. expected_drifts = fixtures whose declared-vs-measured mismatch is a KNOWN, documented modeling gap; a drift OUTSIDE this list is a regression to investigate.

substrate_floor.attribution: R6 wall-time budget watchdog (pgy_budget_wall_watchdog, src/runtime/pgy_runtime_budget.h): pthread_create+pthread_detach spawn the watchdog thread, abort is the wall-budget fail-close. Bucket-B substrate (designed fail-closed enforcement, always-on), landed with task #41; floor moved 0->(Sync 2, Abort 1) at the 2026-07-04 dashboard refresh.
